svg.text: Two pages that shared a record day are back to ordinary within a median of 2 days of each other. Two pages that did not are 27 days apart.
This uses no correlation and no detrending: only the day each page stopped being unusual. Permutation on 29 pairs, 20000 draws, p under 5 in 100,000.
DAYS UNTIL THE PAGE IS BACK AT 1.5 TIMES ITS OWN ORDINARY READING
Lisa Marie Presley + Priscilla Presley + Riley Keough
Kamala Harris + Joe Biden + Jill Biden + Beau Biden
Lionel Messi + Kylian Mbappé + FIFA World Cup
HOW FAR APART TWO PAGES COME DOWN
peaked on the same date · 29 pairs · 62.1% land within three days of each other
peaked within a fortnight of each other · 123 pairs · 14.6% land within three days of each other
peaked more than a fortnight apart · 14,383 pairs · 9.1% land within three days of each other

English Wikipedia daily pageviews, user agents only, Wikimedia REST API. Every article that ever reached the daily top 1,000, 1 July 2015 to 13 August 2026; the 220 largest single reading days on record.

A page with no baseline to come back to, and a page whose title was renamed, carry no day and are left out of their row rather than counted as a zero. One cast loses both of its pages that way and does not appear.
Every figure computed from the file by src/lib/findings.js. Nothing typed by hand.
